descriptions.normal: A bisque that can be found everywhere. Blend cooked ingredients until they are liquefied, and heat the soup with cream until it is thickened up — voila! A simple dish that warms your stomach as well as your heart.
descriptions.suspicious: A bisque that can be found everywhere. A small sip, and the weird taste already freezes you. You can't help but pray: "Archons above, please tell me it's not dirt that I'm tasting..."
descriptions.delicious: A bisque that can be found everywhere. Its creamy texture feels like a silky garment, and you seem to be dancing on the stage in this beautiful attire... The curtain has fallen, but the memory lingers.

effectTexts.normal: Revives a character and restores 400 HP.
effectTexts.suspicious: Revives a character and restores 250 HP.
effectTexts.delicious: Revives a character and restores 550 HP.
